## Goal
Route Agent._callOnce through ChildProcessSupervisor without changing existing Agent.call behavior outside timeout termination.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Timeout exhaustion and every post-deadline close reject as AgentTimeoutError only after observable tree cleanup within the bounded deadline.
- Success, non-zero exit, and spawn-error paths preserve their existing externally visible contracts.
- Direct and descendant processes are absent after timeout settlement.

## Implementation Notes
Retain provider parsing, callbacks, retry, cache, metrics, logging, and schema cleanup in Agent.

## Test Strategy
Shared Agent.call regression tests assert the retained behavior surfaces through the integrated path.
